grandparents_cupboard.reason: Fruit, oats, flour, almonds, sugar, oil and cinnamon are all plain cupboard and garden foods.

supermarket.reason: Every ingredient is a standard Tesco line, and raspberries and apricots are at their everyday summer price in June.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a baking dish, a bowl and a knife, and rubbing in a crumble is beginner technique.

works.reason: The oven temperature, timing and fruit-to-topping ratio give a sound crumble for four, though with only 2 tbsp sugar and none on the fruit it will be on the sharp side.

honest_times.reason: Stoning eight apricots, chopping the almonds and rubbing in the topping fits 15 minutes, and the 25 to 30 minute bake matches the cook time.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and the cinnamon appear in the steps, and nothing unlisted is used.

seasonal_feel.reason: Raspberries at 300g are a full half of the fruit and suit midsummer, and a warm fruit crumble is reasonable in June.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British home-cook instructions.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a fruit-heavy snack with oats and almonds and only modest sugar, so it is real food a family would make again.
